name: omnimed_judge2
cmd: export HF_HOME=/data/dan/hf_cache HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1 python3 src/labeling/run_judge.py --tp 2 --preds ckpts/openvqa/cheap_lingshu7b/ckpt_omnimed_open_lingshu7b_sc8_scexploded.jsonl ckpts/openvqa/cheap_lingshu7b/ckpt_omnimed_open_lingshu7b.jsonl && echo OMNIMED_JUDGE_DONE

name: omnimed_extract2
cmd: export HF_HOME=/data/dan/hf_cache HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1; L7=/data/dan/hf_cache/hub/models--lingshu-medical-mllm--Lingshu-7B/snapshots/b98aecd41dfd9d7545a6b8e2f4743ae8471bd7a9/; for sh in 0 1; do CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$sh python3 src/training_methods/extract_generator_hidden.py --model_path $L7 --mode generator --split eval --eval_ds omnimed_open --stem_tag omnimed --shard $sh --nshard 2 --out feats_hidden > logs/omnimed_extract_s$sh.log 2>&1 & done; wait; echo OMNIMED_EXTRACT_DONE

name: omnimed_donor_curve
cmd: export HEAD_SWEEP_THREADS=8 OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 MKL_NUM_THREADS=8; python3 -X faulthandler src/training_methods/head_omnimed_curve.py --threads 8 --seeds 3

name: kvasir_x1_generate_bo8
cmd: export HF_HOME=/data/dan/hf_cache HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1; L7=/data/dan/hf_cache/hub/models--lingshu-medical-mllm--Lingshu-7B/snapshots/b98aecd41dfd9d7545a6b8e2f4743ae8471bd7a9/; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python3 src/labeling/run_openvqa.py --model_path $L7 --tag lingshu7b_sc8 --dataset kvasir_x1_open --n_samples 8 --temp 0.7 --ckpt_dir ckpts/openvqa/cheap_lingshu7b --tp 1 --max_model_len 4096 && echo KX1_GEN_DONE

name: kvasir_x1_generate_greedy
cmd: export HF_HOME=/data/dan/hf_cache HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1; L7=/data/dan/hf_cache/hub/models--lingshu-medical-mllm--Lingshu-7B/snapshots/b98aecd41dfd9d7545a6b8e2f4743ae8471bd7a9/; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 python3 src/labeling/run_openvqa.py --model_path $L7 --tag lingshu7b --dataset kvasir_x1_open --n_samples 1 --temp 0 --ckpt_dir ckpts/openvqa/cheap_lingshu7b --tp 1 --max_model_len 4096 && echo KX1_GREEDY_DONE
